notes: **2026-09-01** — (branch `fix/mobile-google-signin-sdk55`, rebased onto master `d9688f38`; no schema change) — **NATIVE GOOGLE SIGN-IN REPAIRED + FIVE NATIVE MODULES REALIGNED TO SDK 55** (the owner-approved publish-readiness scope, HANDOFF banner 2026-09-01). `(auth)/google-callback.tsx` destructured `{ default: SecureStore }` from two `await import("expo-secure-store")` calls; the package entry (`build/SecureStore.js`, verified in the installed 55.0.18 — zero `export default`, only named exports incl. the three this file calls) has **no default export**, so on native every token read/write ran on `undefined` and **Google Sign-In had never worked on any native build** — web unaffected via the localStorage branch, which is why it was invisible (L-025's untested-platform-branch class exactly). Both sites now bind the module namespace; every OTHER SecureStore call site in the app already destructured NAMED exports, so this file was the only one carrying the defect. Re-pinned to SDK 55's bundled versions (B203's crash class): `expo-location ~55.1.14`, `expo-task-manager ~55.0.20`, `expo-sharing ~55.0.24`, `@react-native-async-storage/async-storage 2.2.0`, `@react-native-community/netinfo 11.5.2` — ⚠️ **the spec's claim that root `overrides` pins three of these is WRONG**; it pins none (only the RN family + jest + sanitize-html + standardwebhooks), so the change is workspace-manifest-only and editing root would have ADDED pins nobody asked for (L-012 points the same way; the spec-vs-source rule is now L-026). ⚠️ Two of the five were pinned **AHEAD** of SDK 55, not behind (async-storage `^3.1.1`, netinfo `^12.0.1`) — these are deliberate downgrades; both still export a default at the pinned version, so their default imports stay correct, and tsc typechecks against the downgraded types clean. Deleted `react-native-worklets-core` (zero source hits, absent from `bundledNativeModules.json`, autolinked a SECOND JSI worklets runtime beside root-pinned `react-native-worklets@0.7.4`). Added `expo.install.exclude: ["jest","@types/react"]` so `expo install --check` can become a gate instead of exiting 1 forever. **Versioning is now REMOTE:** `app.json` `version 1.1.1` + `android.versionCode` DELETED, `eas.json` `appVersionSource: "remote"` — `local` + production `autoIncrement` was a duplicate-versionCode generator (cloud builds discard the local write, parallel worktrees can't see each other's counter, Play rejects a reused code); safe because `runtimeVersion.policy` is `appVersion`, not the incompatible `nativeVersion`. `app.config.js` needed no change (it spreads `config.android`). ⚠️ **Lockfile discipline across the #574 rebase:** the lockfile was never textually merged — master's copy was taken whole, then regenerated from the merged manifest with `npx -y npm@10.8.0` (local npm is 11.9.0 and rewrites entry shapes). #574's four mobile bumps (`@react-navigation/bottom-tabs 7.18.18`, `@sentry/react 10.72.0`, `@tanstack/react-query 5.102.8`, `axios 1.20.0`) and all five SDK-55 pins coexist — verified in the regenerated lock, not assumed; `validate-lock` `missing 0`.
